comment: dokick.c really_kick_object() 711-713 and 583: a debug Valkyrie drops 400 wished gold pieces in open floor and kicks them; the 1-in-20 roll that does not scatter them leaves a pile over 300 coins, so 'Thump!' (seed from a port scan of 5530001-5530260 for a non-scattering kick with floor beyond). She then puts on a wished amulet of magical breathing, wishes pools (wizard terrain wishes) under herself and under a dropped dagger one square north, sinks into her pool and kicks north until the 1-in-2 underwater kick connects, so the range is cut for a hero in water (583).
